{{Top|leg}}
The '''Great Battles of the Empire''' series was published by [[Plescinia Entertainments/Legends|Plescinia Entertainments]]. They were holographic combat scenarios for use with their [[CS-Mark 10]] command combat simulator. Among the battles included in the package were the [[Siege of Trasemene]], the [[Assault on Vardoss IV]], and the [[Battle of Galboron]].
